Senior Software Engineer

Company: Example Labs

Location: Arlington, VA (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time

About the role

We are hiring a senior software engineer to build data pipelines and statistical reporting tools used by clinical research teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Python services that generate trial reports.
  • Collaborate with biostatisticians on reproducible analysis workflows.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field
  • 5 years of experience with Python and SQL
  • Required skills: Python, SQL, Git
  • Preferred skills: R, Docker
  • Must be eligible for a Secret security clearance

Compensation

Salary range $140,000 - $170,000 per year, plus benefits.

Work authorization

Applicants must have permanent unrestricted U.S. work authorization.
